help.goal: Move all 52 cards to the four foundations, each built up by suit from ace to king.
steps: Tap a card to pick it up, then tap where it should go.
On the piles, stack down in alternating red and black.
Double-tap a card to send it straight to its foundation.
Tap the face-down stock to turn the next card over.
Tap ⤒ Auto-finish or Deal again when those buttons appear.
notes: Only a king, or a run headed by one, may move onto an empty pile.
The stock can be turned over again and again; passes are unlimited.
A card already on a foundation can be pulled back onto a pile.
